The per-wallet tape was captured from GMGN's 1h Smart Inflow table (Monitor > Smart / Callout at https://gmgn.ai/monitor?chain=sol&tab=smartdegen), not from token-level S-Flow aggregates. The left-rail Smart Degen mini feed was not used as the tape (it was used only to resolve full wallet addresses when a visible /sol/address/ href matched a board label by first 4 and last 4 characters). The board is a set of per-token cards, each listing up to 3 wallet rows, and it reorders every few seconds. The Monitor URL added a ref query param after load; the Smart tab and 1h timeframe were selected. Pass-1 cards that later scrolled out of the DOM kept their first-read rows. Later passes added only rows not already seen (wallet+token+action+usd+CA). Pass 1 stored 36 unique rows; pass 2 added 10; pass 3 added 22; pass 4 added 52, for 120 unique rows. The board held about 15-18 cards, which limited further unique rows. All stored inflow rows have a token CA from the card href.
